name: Get Even Mt Eden 2022

venue.name: Dominion Road School Hall
venue.address: Dominion Road School, 14 Quest Terrace, Mount Roskill, Auckland, 1041

information: Get Even Mt Eden 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
